facts.fact: TradeMark Africa reports that the customs systems of Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda and Burundi are interconnected through the East African Community Single Customs Territory Centralised Platform, unveiled in revamped form on 27 January 2025.
facts.system: EAC Single Customs Territory Centralised Platform

facts.fact: TradeMark Africa reports that the customs systems of Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda and Burundi are interconnected through the East African Community Single Customs Territory Centralised Platform, with Kenya's ports authority also connected and scanner image sharing first implemented between Kenya and Uganda in 2024.
facts.system: EAC Single Customs Territory Centralised Platform
